prBodyNotes: This moves the Go release the images are compressed with, so **every image digest changes**.
`TestGoldenLayerDigest` fails by design: update its two constants in this PR, and say in the release notes that consumers pinning by digest must re-pull.

This PR is opened as soon as Go publishes the release, off the weekly schedule. The locked `go-overlay` is usually older than the release, so CI fails with ``attribute '"X.Y.Z"' missing`` until you run `nix flake update go-overlay` on this branch and push. go-overlay adds a release's manifest within hours of go.dev; if the update finds none yet, try again later.

packageRules.description: These actions tag their releases vN only, with no vN.N.N. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver extracts vN.N.N tags only, so it would find no versions for them; take vN here.

customManagers.description: The Go release pinned in flake.nix and provided by go-overlay. Moving it re-digests every image nix-oci writes (DESIGN.md), so it is proposed as its own PR rather than riding along with a nixpkgs bump.
